safety.title: Keep your ledger recoverable
safety.description: Portable backups are password-encrypted and verified before use. LedgerKit never stores the recovery password; keep it separately.
safety.locked: Locked — enter the password to create or resume backups
safety.unlocked: Available only for this app session
safety.passwordHelp: Use at least 12 characters. Losing this password means the encrypted backup cannot be recovered.
safety.restoreConfirm: I understand restore replaces the active ledger only after validation and creates a verified pre-restore snapshot.
safety.privacyNotice: XLSX, CSV, and reconciliation exports can contain private names, notes, identifiers, and financial values. Diagnostics contain only IDs, versions, error categories, and counts.
safety.privacyConfirm: I reviewed the privacy notice and will save this export to an appropriate location.
